message: 迅雷天使のキューピッド

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong, Nanaka? You're awfully quiet today」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I-I-I am not! I'm acting just like I always do!」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Today's soba is different from usual, ya know? Try to remember what breakfast was like, Master Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「It was delicious」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tsk, tsk, tsk, this is why people with no sense of taste are such a pain. This morning's noodles were subpar, weren't they?」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you, they were delicious. I was just as satisfied as I was yesterday and every day before that」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, sure, in terms of nutritional value, it wasn't any different from usual. But what about the firmness and chewiness of the noodles?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Buckwheat flour doesn't bind together so easily, see. You gotta add a binder like egg or wheat flour」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pros pull that off with exquisite skill, making noodles that bring out the true flavor of the buckwheat... That's the very reason yours truly named soba 'soba', ya know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not even listening, are ya. Sheesh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? Oh, yeah... Misa's late today」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, we usually meet up right here」

name: Paqy
message: 「If anything, it was unnatural up until now, wasn't it? What're the odds of bumping into each other 'by coincidence' every single morning?」

name: Synn
message: 「Anyway, let's wait for Misa to get here」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah, good idea」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa...」

name: Paqy
message: 「The warning bell's gonna ring soon, ya know? Shouldn't you guys hurry up?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's go, Synn」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're right, being late would be bad. We must've just missed each other this morning, so let's head on to the academy too」

name: Misa
message: 「It's not like I promised to meet up with you, Sakura-kun, right?」
The Student Council room during lunch break.
As the officers gathered and worked diligently on their respective tasks without wasting a moment, I asked Misa a question.
...Is it just my imagination? Misa is answering quite talkatively. Something feels off.

name: Misa
message: 「When we run into each other on the way to school, it turns into a race-walk. We ought to avoid pointless competitions.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on, didn't you say it wasn't a race-walk? Besides, for Misa to throw away a competition...」

name: Misa
message: 「M-My competition with you isn't over, Sakura-kun! Aren't we right in the middle of settling once and for all which of us is more suited to be Student Council President!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that right?」
I feel uneasy inside, somehow unable to make sense of it. Even listening to Misa's words, they feel subtly contradictory.
Up until now, Misa made logical statements about even the smallest things, so what is this strange feeling?

name: Misa
message: 「Oh dear! There's an oversight in the setup for the special stage.」

name: Synn
message: 「Where, where?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't look!! I see what you're up to--you're planning to steal my work and hog all the credit, aren't you? I won't let you!!」

name: Misa
message: 「I have to dig through last year's files and look into renting musical equipment!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll help too!」

name: Misa
message: 「No, that won't be necessary. For something of this level, I'm plenty enough on my own. I'll leave the rest to the two of you, Sakura-kun and Nanaka-san.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「L-Leave it to us.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Scribble, scribble... Eek! Vice President, please speak a bit more coherently!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What's gotten into you? Up until yesterday you stated the main points concisely, which made my job as secretary so much easier.」

name: Misa
message: 「My! You're saying you'll help me excavate the files, Lolotte-san!? Thank you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I didn't say anything like thaaat~」

name: Misa
message: 「Never mind that, you're coming too!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mgyuu~, please don't drag me by the scruff of my neeeck~」
Misa... even though she just said she was plenty enough on her own...

name: Synn
message: 「Misa and Lolotte are inspecting files in the corner, and Senpai is reading through the request forms while making tea... Looks like the only ones with free hands are the two of us.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I guess so.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, hmm... let's think about how to make use of the open space.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yes!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-What, what!? Did I say something weird?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, I just thought that was a really energetic reply」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right?! I'm always full of energy, y'kno--」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, what's wrong? Why are you fidgeting?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I am not...!」

name: Synn
message: 「But your face is bright red and you're trembling... Ah! You're catching a cold, aren't you. Let's go to the infirmary」

name: Nanaka
message: 「T-To the infirmary with Synn!? N-No way, I'm not ready for that yet...」

name: Synn
message: 「Not a cold? Then... are you... holding in... the bathroom?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wrong about that too?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...*nod, nod*」

name: Synn
message: 「That's the warning bell. Lunch break's over」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's pick up the rest of Student Council after school. For now, good work everyone」

name: Nanaka
message: 「G-Good work~...」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, right, Synn-kun. Sorry, I can't... make it today either. My big sister called me in...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm~. Senpai has been visiting the Chairwoman every day lately」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aha, the two of you are eating something delicious together, aren't you? That's not fair, take me with you too!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sure, if you don't mind only getting super bitter coffee and chocolate that isn't sweet at all?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek, things like that aren't even food!」

name: Misa
message: 「If it's tea and sweets you want, I'll prepare them. So--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Vice President, I love you!」

name: Misa
message: 「L-Like I said, before confessing to me, let's finish our Student Council work」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister, please don't worry either. I'll make sure the Holy Night Festival preparations are well in hand so you can join us anytime\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, thanks」

name: Synn
message: 「It's reassuring for me too having you here, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's with you! Never mind me... you're the President, so get a firmer grip on yourself!」

name: Synn
message: 「Good point. Well then, I'll go walk Nanaka over」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Where?」

name: Synn
message: 「To the infirmary, obviously. You're definitely acting weird today, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's nothing wrong with me at all... so there!」

name: Synn
message: 「I know you best, Nanaka. We're childhood friends, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You don't... know a thing...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine, Nanaka. They won't give you a shot or anything. Go rest in the infirmary before you actually get sick」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, let's go together」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee, do your best...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tehee! Fit as a fiddle! Thanks to taking a nap in the infirmary, I'm totally back to normal」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, were you just feeling feverish from lack of sleep? I wasted my time worrying」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shaddup! A maiden's got all sorts of things going on!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why was your face so red?」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Did it flare back up again?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer, Treasurer! Is it true that if you go to the infirmary, the doctor gives you special juice to drink?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, that? Only if you get heatstroke in the summer. In winter like right now, they only give you plain hot water」

name: Synn
message: 「Plain hot water is great, isn't it? Sipping it slowly really sinks in and calms the mind」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How disappointing. I don't want just plain hot water」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's hurry up and finish the Holy Night Festival so we can skip right to next summer. 'In joy and in sorrow, out with the old year, in with the new'」

name: Misa
message: 「M-Motives aside, I approve of working hard on Student Council duties」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe, how's that for enthusiasm♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, let's call it a day here」

name: Synn
message: 「The sun hasn't even set yet? Usually we keep going right until the final dismissal bell, don't we」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's fine every once in a while. If we stay late every day, our bodies won't hold up. Preparations for the Holy Night Festival are going smoothly anyway」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Excuse me for heading out first~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Roro-chan, so fast!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Grandpa is making chiffon cake for me tonight. If there's any left over, I'll bring it in as a treat tomorrow. Bye-bye~」

name: Synn
message: 「...There's no way there'll be leftovers」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Agreed」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh? You and Nanaka-san really are on the same wavelength, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I mean, anyone would... Even you think so, right, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nngh... I-Indeed」

name: Misa
message: 「Ahem. Anyway, you two are childhood friends and know each other inside and out, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Therefore, Sakura-kun, you are to escort Nanaka-san all the way home! That is an order from the Vice President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ehh, what kind of order is that?! Besides, that has nothing to do with the Student Council!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, I was already planning to walk Nanaka home without needing to be told」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tehehe...」

name: Synn
message: 「There's no way I'd let a friend with a fever walk home alone」

name: Misa
message: 「Sigh... Good grief...」

name: Misa
message: 「Just to be safe, take care of Nanaka-san, okay? I'll stay behind and organize the minutes」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll help too」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sakura-kun, were you even listening to me?」

name: Synn
message: 「You said we should wrap things up early today and get some good rest, right? Even so, I can't just leave you behind all by yourself, Misa」

name: Synn
message: 「You're the one who suggested it, so there can't be that much leftover work, right? If the three of us split it up, we'll be done in no time」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh? W-Well, that's, um......」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa...」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-That was just a joke! Hmph, I'm competent, you know. I finished today's share ages ago」

name: Synn
message: 「Then let's all three head home together」

name: Nanaka
message: 「M-Misa. Don't worry about me......」

name: Misa
message: 「I suppose I have no choice. If you don't mind parting ways partway, I'll grace you with my company on the walk home」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't that how it always goes?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaa! Stop nitpicking everything I say!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's been a while since I walked home with you like this, Synn......」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm telling you, it's true」

name: Paqy
message: 「Soba's right, ya know? You two stick together every morning, so you probably don't even realize it, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah. ......True, I have been walking home with Misa a lot lately」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, where is Misa anyway? *looks around*」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-What is it! Don't turn around!」

name: Synn
message: 「......Why are you walking so far behind us?」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph. I'm maintaining the prime position behind you so I can stomp all over your shadow, Sakura-kun! Take that, take that!」

name: Misa
message: 「What, what?! Stop looking at me like I'm some pitiful little kid!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Take that, take that, take that!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey, why are you jumping in to step on my shadow too, Nanaka-san?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahahaha!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, don't you have a slight fever? Your face is all red.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-The sunset's just really warm, okay!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it is. It's a dazzling evening sun, almost as if someone filled in the zero on a test paper with red ink.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wh-What kind of failed avant-garde poet metaphor is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「I took proper notes for the classes you missed while resting in the nurse's office.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll lend them to you later, so if there's anything you don't understand, feel free to ask.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-Thanks」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urgh……」

name: Synn
message: 「So, Misa. How long are you going to keep playing shadow tag?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sh-Shut up! Don't just scold me, tell Nanaka-san too!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sh-Synn! Um, listen……」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Misa
message: 「You got this, Nanaka-san!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Um…… You've gotten faster at walking, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「You've just gotten slower, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not it. It's because you've been racing Misa every morning……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What if, you know? If I had challenged you to a race, would you have done the same for me every morning?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get what you're asking. You wouldn't do something like that, Nanaka. What are you trying to say?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um, uh, uhh……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I just wanted to say that Pacific saury really is best in autumn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I totally agree! The key is sudachi lime, grated daikon, and soy sauce. Man, that stuff is delicious!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, that's Synn for ya--you totally get it!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey...! Nanaka-san!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorr-y!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah... I-I see. With me around, you can't say what you want to say, can you?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, I have some shopping to do, so I'll take my leave now!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「Well then, both of you, farewell--」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh-ho, the three of you. What a coincidence this is.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sh-Shio, why are you here?」

name: Shio
message: 「Because this is a public thoroughfare under heaven.」

name: Shio
message: 「Dear Sister proclaimed her shopping trip in a loud voice, did she not? This one is doing the same.」

name: Shio
message: 「If it pleases you, would Lord Synn and Lady Nanaka care to accompany us?」

name: Shio
message: 「The sun will set before long, and the air shall grow chilly. Let us all partake in a cup of hot tea--」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, I appreciate the invite, but Nanaka's just getting over an illness. We'll pass this time. You and Misa go have fun together.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sh-Synn, I'm not sick at all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry. Just remembered something urgent, I'm heading back first!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't push yourself too hard.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm not!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You know, what Paqy said this morning. About the soba tasting kinda off.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe it was stored badly and the buckwheat flour caught a cold. If Yuugiri-an's flavor drops, it'll be a huge disaster! I gotta check right now!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-Bye-bye!」

name: Misa
message: 「She took off...」

name: Shio
message: 「S-So fast. Just as she herself stated, she hardly seems like one recovering from an illness.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka...」
Bathed in the sunset, Nanaka's long-stretched shadow soon vanished from sight.
I suddenly remember playing shadow tag with Nanaka and the others when we were little.
With my dad gone and only a lonely house waiting for me, Nanaka was always the one who stayed and played with me until the very end.
At twilight, shadows stretch on and on. At a glance, it feels like it'd be easy to win at shadow tag.
In reality, though, it's harder than during the day.
I still don't know the reason why.
...How many years ago was it that I last ran and laughed together with Nanaka?
